mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate signals accommodative monetary policy that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.2%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.5% for two consecutive months, it signals a deteriorating labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and retail sales indicates broad-based consumer demand weakness that triggers negative equity market sentiment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 105 (indicating a supply shock), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to rising production costs and reduced corporate output.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is below 105, or the Rank IC for the INDPRO < 105 condition is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment signals strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS growth is positive, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPI exceeds 2.5%, it signals accelerating inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 2.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and GDP growth indicates a contraction in the real economy that triggers negative equity market reactions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and GDPC1 fails to predict negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-interest-rate regime (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%), the S&P 500 experiences positive forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the central bank maintains accommodative policy to support economic growth.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.
